alarms.description: 51 phase overcurrent element picked up (≥1.25× I_nominal)
alarms.operator_action:
Investigate downstream fault. Lock-out / tag-out before any close.
Verify CT polarity if event is unexpected. Capture event report.

alarms.description: 50BF breaker-failure timer expired — main breaker did not interrupt
alarms.operator_action:
Immediate. Open upstream backup device. Do NOT attempt re-close.
Field-verify breaker physical state (closed/open) before any action.

alarms.description: Optical arc-flash sensor triggered — light + current confirmed
alarms.operator_action:
Personnel must clear the room immediately. Do not approach until
thermal-imaging clearance + de-energization confirmed. Notify
on-call electrical engineer. Document for OSHA arc-flash incident report.

alarms.description: Breaker close command issued; close coil did not energize
alarms.operator_action:
Verify close coil continuity + DC control voltage at the cabinet.
Coordinate with maintenance to test close circuit before next attempt.
Do not strip back the alarm without coil swap or cause confirmed.
alarms.reference_doc: ABB SafeGear Service Manual §4 (Control Circuit Diagnostics)

alarms.description: Leak-detection sensor on secondary (TCS) loop triggered
alarms.operator_action:
Immediate. Command CDU to shutdown via Redfish action. Isolate
secondary loop manual valves. Personnel to evacuate compute container
if pooling observed. Notify facilities — coolant is dielectric but
slip + electrical-equipment exposure are real hazards.

alarms.description: Primary-loop pump did not start or has stalled
alarms.operator_action:
Immediate. CDU has redundant pumps — verify secondary pump took over
via Redfish PumpState query. If both failed, schedule emergency GPU
workload drain (CDUs can't sustain thermal load without pumps).
Replace pump before resuming primary loop.

alarms.description: Secondary-loop flow rate below configured minimum
alarms.operator_action:
Check secondary-loop manifold valves are fully open. Verify pump
speed matches setpoint via Redfish. Inspect supply-side filters.
If flow stays low > 5 min, escalate to GPU power throttling.

alarms.description: AC control-power input lost; CDU running on last-known-value fallback
alarms.operator_action:
Verify rack PDU outlet supplying CDU control power. If outlet OK,
check CDU AC/DC supply. CDU will continue cooling on last setpoint
but cannot accept new commands until control power is restored —
avoid GPU workload shifts during this window.
